question: What distinct receipt numbers correspond to someone who bought a good that costs more than 13 dollars?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "price_catalog" AS SELECT "flavor" AS "flavor", "food" AS "food", "price" AS "price", "id_part1" AS "id_part1", "id_part2" AS "id_part2", "id_part3" AS "id_part3", "id_part4" AS "id_part4", "id_part5" AS "id_part5" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "receipt_attributes" AS SELECT "receipt" AS "receipt", "ordinal" AS "ordinal", "attribute" AS "attribute", "value" AS "value" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH catalog AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(CAST(id_part1 AS VARCHAR),'') AS p1,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part2), '') AS p2,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part3), '') AS p3,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part4), '') AS p4,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part5), '') AS p5,
    price
  FROM price_catalog
),
cat_codes AS (
  SELECT
    price,
    /* build hyphen-joined code with available parts */
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      TRIM(
        CONCAT_WS('-', p1,
          COALESCE(p2, NULL),
          COALESCE(p3, NULL),
          COALESCE(p4, NULL),
          COALESCE(p5, NULL)
        )
      ),
      '-+$',''
    ) AS item_code
  FROM catalog
),
receipt_items AS (
  SELECT receipt, TRIM(value) AS item_code
  FROM receipt_attributes
  WHERE UPPER(attribute) = 'ITEM' AND value IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(value) <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.receipt AS receipt
FROM receipt_items r
JOIN cat_codes c
  ON UPPER(r.item_code) = UPPER(c.item_code)
WHERE c.price > 13
ORDER BY receipt
S:
# Assumption: receipt_attributes encodes item identity in value compatible with concatenation of id_part* from price_catalog; extract item code from value and match against catalog to filter price>13, then return distinct receipts.
from math import nan

# Build candidate item codes from price_catalog by concatenating non-null id parts with '-' to match patterns like '51-APR'.
# Also keep price.
create_codes_sql = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH catalog AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(CAST(id_part1 AS VARCHAR),'') AS p1,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part2), '') AS p2,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part3), '') AS p3,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part4), '') AS p4,
    NULLIF(TRIM(id_part5), '') AS p5,
    price
  FROM price_catalog
),
cat_codes AS (
  SELECT
    price,
    /* build hyphen-joined code with available parts */
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      TRIM(
        CONCAT_WS('-', p1,
          COALESCE(p2, NULL),
          COALESCE(p3, NULL),
          COALESCE(p4, NULL),
          COALESCE(p5, NULL)
        )
      ),
      '-+$',''
    ) AS item_code
  FROM catalog
),
receipt_items AS (
  SELECT receipt, TRIM(value) AS item_code
  FROM receipt_attributes
  WHERE UPPER(attribute) = 'ITEM' AND value IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(value) <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.receipt AS receipt
FROM receipt_items r
JOIN cat_codes c
  ON UPPER(r.item_code) = UPPER(c.item_code)
WHERE c.price > 13
ORDER BY receipt
'''
